evidence: Nestled along the winding lakeside road of West Lake, Tao Sach Pagoda, also known as Tào Sách, stands as a serene Buddhist sanctuary that has captivated visitors for centuries. Founded in the sixteenth century during the Mạc Dynasty, the pagoda was originally constructed on the site of the former residence of the revered Prince Linh Lang, adding a layer of historical significance to its tranquil ambiance.
